properties.documentation: Integer x, y, width, and height relative to the parent; width and height are positive.
Optional 16-bit runtime view and default action identifier; zero means unassigned.
RGBA background color; a transparent value leaves the existing surface visible.
RGBA foreground color used for text and primary strokes.
RGBA accent color used for selection, progress, focus, and active state.
RGBA border color; transparent disables a visible border even when width is nonzero.
Bounded focused-state background token. Named theme colors may be selected instead of a literal.
Bounded focused-state text and stroke token. Named theme colors may be selected instead of a literal.
Bounded pointer-pressed background token. Named theme colors may be selected instead of a literal.
Bounded pointer-pressed text and stroke token. Named theme colors may be selected instead of a literal.
Bounded disabled-state background token. Named theme colors may be selected instead of a literal.
Bounded disabled-state text and stroke token. Named theme colors may be selected instead of a literal.

Bounded selected-state background token for a latched toggle button, checked checkbox, or selected radio button. Omitted keeps the normal background; disabled, pressed, and focused states take precedence. Named theme colors may be selected instead of a literal.
Bounded selected-state text, icon, and stroke token. Omitted keeps the normal foreground. Named theme colors may be selected instead of a literal.
Legacy four-bit horizontal and vertical text-alignment encoding.
Integer nearest-neighbor scale applied by the selected font backend.
Border width in target pixels; zero disables border drawing.
Initial visibility. XML stores the inverse historical hide flag.
Initial interaction state; disabled views remain renderable but cannot receive focus.
Auto uses the widget default; true or false emits an explicit canFocus override.
Borrowed UTF-8 display text whose storage must outlive the built layout.
Secondary borrowed UTF-8 text displayed by widgets that provide a detail line.
Momentary buttons are non-latching and report one action for each completed activation. Toggle buttons latch the selected state, flip it before reporting each activation, and draw a latch indicator.
Optional borrowed bitmap drawn before the text, or centered when the button has no text or detail. Alpha1 and alpha8 icons are tinted with the resolved state foreground.
Optional font resource name; an empty value selects the caller-provided default font.
Initial progress value clamped to the inclusive range zero through one hundred.
Required bitmap resource name resolved by ResourceProvider during bounded layout construction.
Required ordered bitmap-name sequence emitted as consecutive animationImageN attributes.
Caller-clocked interval between animation frames.
Frame index selected after the last frame, enabling an intro followed by a loop.
Starts animation when the view is built; elapsed time remains caller-owned.
Scrollable content extent; zero allows the runtime to fit content from children.
Initial nonnegative vertical content offset.
Positive vertical distance moved by one key-driven scroll operation.
Enables the compact draggable scroll indicator.
Pipe-delimited picker items or tab titles retained in caller-owned immutable storage.
Initial picker item or tab; the runtime clamps a picker value, and tabs require an existing tab.
Allows left/right selection to wrap between the first and last items or tabs.
Height of the tab strip; pages use tab-view coordinates and start at or below it.
Height of a wheel or drop-down list row in pixels.
Initial Boolean state of a checkbox or toggle button; a momentary button cannot be checked.
Initial radio-button selection state.
Required application-owned mutable text-buffer binding resolved by ResourceProvider.
Borrowed text displayed while the bound text buffer is empty.
Optional UTF-8 byte limit, additionally clamped to the caller-owned buffer capacity minus one.
Borrowed label for the left softkey region.
Borrowed label for the right softkey region.
Action ID emitted when the left softkey is selected.
Action ID emitted when the right softkey is selected.

widgets.help: General fixed-capacity container and the canonical root of a designed form.
Static borrowed UTF-8 text rendered with the selected or default font.
Focusable button with text, an optional icon, and momentary (non-latching) or toggle (latching) behavior.
Bitmap rendered at its native size from a caller-owned immutable resource.
Caller-clocked sequence of immutable bitmap resources with bounded frame storage.
Bitmap centered within the assigned frame.
Horizontal or vertical rule selected from the frame aspect ratio.
Vertically translated child container with bounded key and pointer scrolling.
Scrollable fixed-child container using the same bounded behavior as Scroll Panel.
Focus-driven delimiter-backed choice picker without dynamic allocation.
Focusable Boolean choice that toggles when activated.
Focusable radio-style Boolean choice; grouping policy remains application-owned.
Bounded UTF-8 editor over an application-owned mutable text buffer.
Two-region softkey bar with independent left and right action IDs.
Equal-width strip of up to sixteen tabs. Left/right, select, or a pointer release on a tab changes the selection and reports the action.
Tab strip above one container page per tab; only the selected tab's page is visible and reachable by focus.

Vertical scroll wheel of up to 255 items with the selection centered in a band. Select or encoder push starts and ends editing; while editing, up/down or the encoder turn it and back restores the starting value. A drag scrolls and snaps; a tap selects the row under it.

Compact selector with up to 255 immutable pipe-delimited items. Select opens or commits; arrows navigate; Back, focus loss or an outside press cancels. Tap a row to commit; drag the popup to scroll. At most five rows are shown, below or above the control within the root surface.
